name: strategy-graph
description: Assess a strategy and ask the questions that improve it, from a knowledge graph of the strategy practitioner method.
long_description:
A Socratic coaching server over a 653-node graph of the strategy practitioner method drawn from Roger L. Martin's Strategy Practitioner Insights series.

It assesses a strategy against 54 checkable tests and returns the ranked question that follows from the weakest point — and it deliberately will not write the strategy. A strategy the user did not choose is one they cannot defend, cascade, or resource.

The division of labour is the point: the graph decides structure (which tests apply, what gates what, which question follows from which gap) deterministically, so every question is traceable rather than improvised. The calling agent supplies the verdicts, because judging whether a stated way of winning really resolves to a cost advantage is a reading task.

Standard library only — nothing to install, nothing to resolve.

tools.name: strategy_load_context
tools.description: Load the assessment framework: pillars in order, principles, failure patterns, tests with pass/fail signals, slots.

tools.name: strategy_search
tools.description: Search the graph by keyword to find a node id.

tools.name: strategy_get_pillar
tools.description: The full assessment kit for one area of strategy.

tools.name: strategy_get_concept
tools.description: One concept with its practitioner note, relations and citations.

tools.name: strategy_get_test
tools.description: One test with its pass/fail signals, weight and probing questions.

tools.name: strategy_get_trap
tools.description: One failure pattern with its observable signals and coaching move.

tools.name: strategy_explain_link
tools.description: Shortest path between two nodes, to justify a question.

tools.name: strategy_list_corpus
tools.description: The indexed source material by title, URL and date. Metadata only.

tools.name: strategy_prescreen
tools.description: Unverified regex hints over a pasted strategy document.

tools.name: strategy_assess
tools.description: Per-pillar readiness, blocking failures and a ranked gap list from a strategy state.

tools.name: strategy_next_questions
tools.description: The ranked question queue, each entry carrying why it was chosen.

tools.name: strategy_coverage_report
tools.description: Questions asked versus available, by pillar.

tools.name: strategy_session_plan
tools.description: Preview several rounds of questioning without changing state.
